title: Finite affine sections of a coherent module
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], F a coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent], and U an affine open. Gamma(U,F) is finitely generated over Gamma(U,O_X) [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. No Noetherian hypothesis is needed.

source.place: the coherent-to-finite-presentation construction in isCoherent_iff_isQuasicoherent_and_isFiniteType; Stacks Tags 01BV, 01BO and 01PC

proof.text: Choose finite local generators. Reindex them by ULift (Fin n); coherence makes the kernel of each generator epimorphism finite type. Apply the existing private isFinitePresentation_of_generators_kernel via a proof-only import all of CoherentFiniteTypeLocallyNoetherian: its restriction and cokernel construction gives finite presentations from these finite generators and finite-type kernels, without any Noetherian hypothesis. Apply locality of finite presentation.
Apply the source-library affine sections theorem to the resulting global finite presentation. Finitely presented ring modules are finite.
